Diagnose prediction-domain support and index dependence

Source: R/index-domain.R, R/index-domain-methods.R
index_domain.Rd

Classify an explicit prediction domain, decompose native link predictors, and compare full-domain indices with restricted-domain and term-omission predictions. No model is refitted.

Usage

index_domain(
  model,
  reference_data,
  year = NULL,
  sampled = NULL,
  sampled_definition = c("cell_time", "cell_ever", "cell_always"),
  min_obs = 1L,
  min_years = 1,
  sampled_only = TRUE,
  area = NULL,
  area_units = NULL,
  response_units = NULL,
  reference_weights = NULL,
  decompose = TRUE,
  omit = character(),
  where = c("unsampled", "all"),
  covariate_reference = "sampled_mean",
  ndraws = 500L,
  seed = 1L,
  batch_size = 250L,
  draw_batch_size = 100L,
  retain_cells = NULL,
  uncertainty = c("auto", "none"),
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
  trend_window = NULL,
  core_threshold = 0.05,
  unsampled_threshold = 0.5,
  share_change_threshold = 0.2,
  prediction_offset = NULL,
  units = NULL,
  omission_definition = c("cell_time", "cell_ever", "cell_always"),
  data = NULL,
  spatial_terms = NULL,
  spatiotemporal_terms = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'influ_domain'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  ...,
  what = c("coverage", "decomposition", "omission", "sampled_only", "partition", "trend")
)

# S3 method for class 'influ_domain'
summary(
  object,
  ...,
  what = c("coverage", "decomposition", "omission", "sampled_only", "partition", "trend")
)

# S3 method for class 'influ_domain'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'influ_domain'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("sampled_only", "coverage", "decomposition", "omission", "partition", "share",
    "map"),
  show_probs = TRUE,
  coords = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  terms = NULL,
  components = NULL,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'influ_domain'
autoplot(object, ...)

Arguments

model

A complete fitted sdmTMB, univariate tinyVAST, or single-predictor mgcv::gam() model.

reference_data

A non-empty prediction data frame without year.

year

Year column; defaults to the model's native time variable, or the first formula predictor for a GAM.

sampled

Sampling rule: a shared cell-ID column, a list list(coords = c("X", "Y"), distance = d), or a logical matrix with reference rows and years in index order. When omitted or NULL, use half the nearest distinct grid-centre spacing, with a warning. Supply a rule explicitly when this default does not describe the sampling design. GAMs always require an explicit rule; coordinates are not inferred. Cell-ID and coordinate rules count observed fitted responses with positive likelihood weights and, where applicable, positive trial counts. A logical matrix instead declares support directly; its interpretation is the caller's responsibility.

sampled_definition

One or more of "cell_time", "cell_ever", "cell_always". All are computed by default for sampled-only comparisons.

min_obs

Minimum observations per cell-year.

min_years

Minimum sampled years for "cell_ever"; a positive count, or a proportion strictly between zero and one (rounded up).

sampled_only

Return a restricted index for each definition?

area

Optional explicit cell areas (numeric values or a column name). Supplying areas requests totals rather than weighted means.

area_units, response_units

Required unit strings when supplying area.

reference_weights

Non-negative reference weights. With area these are within-cell averaging weights, multiplied by area and not normalised internally. For a seasonal mean, supply weights summing to one within each spatial cell. Otherwise sum(area * reference_weights) is effective weighted area, not necessarily unique geographic area.

decompose

Summarise link-scale terms by year and domain class?

omit

Native term names to omit, including "year", "spatial", "spatiotemporal" and "svc". "spatial" removes persistent and SVC fields together, matching spatial_fields = "spatiotemporal" in cpue_index(); "svc" removes only SVC fields. Unknown names are errors.

where

One or more of "unsampled", "never_sampled", "all".

covariate_reference

"sampled_mean" (default), "zero", or a named list of rules per omitted covariate. A fixed rule is list(rule = "fixed", value = list(depth = 40)).

ndraws, seed, batch_size, draw_batch_size, uncertainty, probs, prediction_offset, units

As in cpue_index().

retain_cells

Optional year labels for which to keep cell-level terms.

trend_window

Optional year labels defining a second trend window.

core_threshold

Warn below this retained-weight share for fixed domains.

unsampled_threshold, share_change_threshold

Flag years exceeding these unsampled-share and consecutive-share-change thresholds.

omission_definition

A single definition for unsampled omission masks; defaults to "cell_time" independently of sampled_definition.

data

For GAMs, optional original observation data retaining fitted row names and values. Use this to supply cell IDs or coordinates not in the saved model frame. Without it only the retained frame is used; mutable external fitting calls are not reevaluated. Native spatial fits use their stored data and do not accept this argument.

spatial_terms, spatiotemporal_terms

For GAMs only, explicit native smooth labels to group under "spatial" or "spatiotemporal". No smooth is classified from its name or dimensionality automatically. Ungrouped smooths retain labels such as "s(X,Y)" and can be omitted by that label.

x, object

An influ_domain result from index_domain().

row.names, optional

Passed to as.data.frame().

...

Reserved for future use.

what

Stored table to extract or summarise: "coverage" (default), "decomposition", "omission", "sampled_only", "partition", or "trend". Index comparisons include the full-domain baseline and a Series column; their stored metadata are attached as index_metadata.

type

Plot "sampled_only" (default), "coverage", "decomposition", "omission", "partition", "share", or "map".

show_probs

Display stored pointwise intervals when available.

coords

Two coordinate column names in retained cell contributions. If NULL, use X/Y, x/y, or lon/lat, when available.

years, terms, components

Optional selectors for map years, terms, and components, matching the stored labels.

Value

An influ_domain containing ordinary influ_index objects in baseline, sampled_only, and omission; coverage, decomposition, response-scale partition and trend tables; shared annual partition_draws; and optional retained_cells.

Table methods return a data frame, with index metadata attached for index comparisons. print() invisibly returns its input. Plot methods return a ggplot, or a patchwork for sampled-only and omission comparisons.

Details

The default sampling distance is a warned grid-spacing heuristic, not inferred cell areas. Sampling interpretation depends on the supplied cell size or distance. Reporting classes always describe actual same-year support: sampled, previously_sampled (sampled in another year, not necessarily an earlier year), and never_sampled. The chosen definitions govern omission masks and sampled-only domains.

Contributions add on the link scale, separately for delta components; they must not be back-transformed and added on the response scale. Decomposition quantiles use reference-weighted, 1024-bin histograms spanning each group's observed range; their resolution is recorded in metadata. Means and SDs use all positive-weight cells. Only compact annual summaries and histograms are accumulated, unless cells are retained.

Omission is a prediction-target counterfactual, not a refit; use plot_step() to study refitted models. Fields are set to zero; the year term is replaced by its first-year value at the same reference row. Separate year interactions and time-varying terms remain unless selected. "sampled_mean" replaces a covariate's additive contribution by its reference-weighted mean over cells sampled that year, separately in each joint draw and delta component, regardless of omission_definition. It is not the prediction at a mean raw covariate. "zero" is appropriate only for deliberately centred terms. "fixed" reevaluates the term at explicit raw predictor values, retaining its other predictors; this also handles interactions and smooths. These contrasts depend on the fitted decomposition and its centring and identifiability constraints. Correlated terms can share signal; omission is not a causal effect or a unique allocation of importance or variance.

Weighted-mean restricted indices renormalise weights each year. An empty restricted mean is undefined (NA); an empty restricted total is zero. "cell_time" is a variable-domain diagnostic, not an alternative index. Use this object's sampled-only plot for intentional comparisons of different domain areas. Ordinary index_ratio() and plot_compare() preserve their equal-area safeguards; do not change area metadata to bypass them.

GAMs use blocked native linear-predictor matrices and jointly sampled coefficients. Smoothing-parameter corrected covariance is used when available; otherwise it is conditional on fitted smoothing parameters. Likelihood nuisance parameters are held fitted. This is Gaussian coefficient-simulation uncertainty, not new MCMC or the delta-method approximation used by ordinary cpue_index() GAM summaries. Natural single-response Gaussian, binomial, Poisson, Gamma, negative-binomial, and Tweedie GAMs are supported; multi-predictor distributional families and transformed responses fail explicitly. Formula offsets are retained. Slopes use numeric year labels when available, otherwise ordered year positions. All comparisons use paired joint Gaussian draws, not independent marginal intervals. Nonpositive series have undefined log comparisons; no small positive replacement is made.

Plotting and table extraction reuse stored results; they do not predict again or refit a model. Sampled-only comparisons divide every displayed series and its interval by the geometric mean over years with finite positive estimates in every displayed series. Weighted means use the full index's geometric mean for every series, preserving level differences. Area totals use each series' own geometric mean over that common period to compare shapes rather than different domain areas. This display-only normalisation leaves stored results unchanged; the lower panel shows coverage, not uncertainty in the sampling process. Unavailable years remain gaps. Other index panels retain the stored index scale. Decomposition ribbons show stored spatial contribution quantiles (Q10 to Q90), not parameter-uncertainty intervals.

Omission is a prediction counterfactual, not a refitted reduced model. Contributions are additive on the link scale, not on the response scale. A sampled-only domain can change between years and is not a fixed-domain abundance index. Classification depends on the declared mapping and sampling thresholds, not on interpolation or a mesh boundary. When no sampling rule is supplied, the default half-grid-spacing distance rule warns: it is a convenience convention, not an inferred survey footprint. All three sampled-only definitions can be compared while omission uses the single stored omission_definition (by default "cell_time"). Year-effect omission uses the first year as its baseline. Covariate omission defaults to the sampled-year mean link contribution as its reference; this is not prediction at a mean response-scale covariate.

cpue_index(), integrate_index(), index_ratio()
